title: Workload Diagnostic Handoff
description: End-to-end diagnostic handoff workflow that executes /troubleshoot to gather findings, verifies destination bucket access, converts triage state, scaffolds GCS repositories, generates manifests and Two-Level Failure Tables, sanitizes payloads, publishes the package and verifies the bucket holds real content, stages partner issue updates, and arms automated background monitoring.

step_notes.workload-disruption-orchestration: Executes /troubleshoot on the target workload to investigate disruption signals, quote culprit hosts from primary logs, resolve complete node scope, and emit the triage state JSON and failure table.
step_notes.verify-handoff-bucket-access: Pre-flight security prober. Verifies write/read capability and ensures publicAccessPrevention: enforced on the target bucket.
step_notes.convert-triage-to-findings: Transforms raw triage state JSON from /troubleshoot into canonical troubleshoot_findings.json adhering to Schema v2.2.
step_notes.scaffold-handoff-bucket: Provisions the multi-job incident structure at gs://<bucket>/<storage_key>/ (BUCKET_STRUCTURE.md, support case link). Never pre-creates empty directory markers (.keep), manifests, READMEs or failure tables; directories in GCS are created on-demand as real files are uploaded.
step_notes.package-handoff-artifacts: Gathers scratch logs and traces, invokes redact_diagnostic_payload.py on HLO graphs, and uploads them under jobs/<workload>/data/ (upload on by default). Artifacts with no source are reported in missing_artifacts, never written as placeholders; any upload failure exits non-zero.
step_notes.generate-handoff-manifests: Emits INCIDENT_MANIFEST.json and JOB_MANIFEST.json with null-propagation for unverified fields into the shared staging --output_dir. Fails on findings validation errors or a missing bucket.
step_notes.generate-two-level-failure-tables: Synthesizes Level A Infrastructure Failure Table (initialized to PENDING_GOOGLE_CORRELATION) and Level B Job Progression Master Disruption Table into the same staging --output_dir.
step_notes.render-handoff-readmes: Renders INCIDENT_OVERVIEW.md, README.md, jobs/<workload>/JOB_README.md and jobs/<workload>/README.md in strict 7-bit ASCII into the same staging --output_dir.
step_notes.post-partner-issue-comment: Renders the update for the Partner Issue Tracker and prints the issue link for the operator to paste. requires_approval; runs only after verify-handoff-package returns VERIFIED.
step_notes.upload-handoff-package: Uploads the staging tree to gs://<bucket>/<storage_key>/. All-or-nothing: refuses if a required file is missing or any file is empty, placeholder-only, or invalid JSON.
step_notes.verify-handoff-package: Lists the published bucket and must return VERIFIED before the partner issue comment is staged or monitoring is armed. INCOMPLETE or VERIFY_FAILED stops the handoff.
